methods: Read-only rev-list and cat-file over every reachable historical blob
Signatures: private keys, GitHub, AWS, Slack, Google, OpenAI, JWT, URL passwords, secret assignments, email and local-path indicators
Recursive ZIP decompression and runtime/cache path checks
SHA-256 comparison of prior supplement snapshot with current files and full text review of four additions/updates
limitations: Bounded signature/pattern audit, not proof that no secrets exist.
No image OCR or semantic extraction of compressed PDF streams.
Unknown or obfuscated credentials may evade detection.
Historical blob report deduplicates identical blobs and uses representative paths.
Negotiated push-pack size was not measured.
Future edits and unrelated artifacts are outside scope.
No remote mutation, push, or credential creation by auditor.
